If you ask again in a new message, I'll start over. I would:
1. Read the six pages above for the traditional verse-by-verse reading (vv. 1–32).
2. Look for differences between Protestant traditions. Where these sources usually comment on this chapter is likely to be:
   - the darkened sky in vv. 7–8
   - Sheol and the Pit in vv. 18–32
   - what "comforted" means in v. 31
3. Check bibleodyssey.org, the NET Bible notes and the Catholic and Orthodox sites for other views. I'd only include them if they actually discuss this chapter.

It may work better to split the job into two requests, vv. 1–16 and vv. 17–32, so that one failure doesn't block everything.
